properties.name: userList
properties.description:
Subsession user list.

Each entry is a subset of {@link Participant} fields plus `isInSubsession`,
which indicates whether the user has actually joined the subsession
(`true`) or has only been assigned to it (`false`).

properties.name: isAutoJoinSubsession
properties.description: Whether a participant should automatically join the subsession when assigned to one.

properties.name: isBackToMainSessionEnabled
properties.description: Whether to allow participants in the subsession to return to the main session.

properties.name: isTimerEnabled
properties.description: Whether to set a timer for the subsession.

properties.name: isTimerAutoEnabled
properties.description: Whether to automatically return to the main session when time is up.

properties.name: waitSeconds
properties.description: When the subsession is closing, the buffer time to leave the subsession.

properties.name: isAutoMoveBackToMainSession
properties.description:
Indicates whether a participant should automatically return to the main session when the host moves them back.

- If `true`, the participant returns automatically without confirmation.
- If `false`, the participant receives a `subsession-invite-back-to-main-session` event and must agree to return.

properties.name: isSubsessionSelectionEnabled
properties.description: Indicates whether participants are allowed to select a subsession to join.

members.name: Automatically
members.description: Automatically create and assign subsessions according to the user number.

declarations.description: The `SubsessionClient` provides methods that define subsession functionalities, such as create subsession, join subsession, and leave subsession.

methods.name: createSubsessions
methods.signature: createSubsessions(data: number | string | Array<string>, pattern?: SubsessionAllocationPattern): Promise<Array<Subsession> | Error>

parameters.name: data
parameters.description:
Accepts the following parameters:
 - number : the number of subsessions to create. The SDK will create the specified number of subsessions, automatically named.
 - string : the name of the subsession. The SDK will create a subsession with the specified name.
 - Array<string>: a list of named subsessions. The specified subsession will be created.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description:
How to assign users to subsessions:
- `SubsessionAllocationPattern.Automatically`: Distribute users evenly to each subsession.
- `SubsessionAllocationPattern.Manually`: The users will be assigned manually later. This is the default.

returns.description:
Promise<Array<Subsession> | Error>
- Subsession List: success
- Error
- `INVALID_OPERATION` (Subsession has started!)
- `INVALID_PARAMETERS` (Exceed maximum size): `maximum_size` = 50; if support big subsessions plan, up to 100

methods.name: joinSubsession
methods.description:
Joins a subsession.
 - Join only after the subsession is open.

methods.name: leaveSubsession
methods.description:
Leaves the subsession.
- If the user is not allowed to leave the subsession, they cannot return to the main session.

methods.description:
Assigns participants to certain subsessions in advance. Available to the host when scheduling a session.
Loads preset subsessions.
Gets the unassigned list of users.

methods.name: getSubsessionList
methods.description:
Gets the list of subsessions.
If you are the host, will get all the subsessions.
If you are the participant, will get the assigned subsession.

**Note:** The `userId` of each participant in `userList` is based on the **main session**.
User IDs are not shared across subsessions or between a subsession and the main session.
Each session context assigns its own independent IDs. Because every participant has a join
record in the main session, the `userId` exposed here always refers to that main-session identity.
If you need to track a user across session contexts, use `userGuid` instead, as it remains
constant regardless of which session the user is in.
